Ask Brookdale about current adult basic education, high-school-equivalency preparation, and ESL classes, including class locations and enrollment requirements. ESL and GED preparation have different eligibility; a college degree does not establish eligibility for every class.

Community College Opportunity Grant (CCOG):
For eligible New Jersey residents pursuing a first degree. Prior associate or bachelor’s degree holders are not eligible for CCOG. Income, enrollment, financial-aid application, and academic-progress requirements apply. Ask Brookdale Financial Aid for the current award levels and qualifying fees.

Pell Grants:
Generally unavailable after a bachelor’s degree and limited to 600% lifetime eligibility; academic-progress and maximum-timeframe rules also apply. Program Overview:
Comprehensive county workforce center combining the Monmouth County Division of Workforce Development / JobSource, the New Jersey Department of Labor (NJDOL), and Equus Workforce Solutions under one roof. Equus operates as the county’s contracted WIOA Title I provider, working directly with the Monmouth County Division of Workforce Development out of the Eatontown office to issue training tuition grants. Provides eligible unemployed and underemployed residents with federally funded WIOA career training grants (up to $4,000–$5,000 in tuition assistance) for approved credentials in healthcare, commercial driving (CDL), IT, and skilled trades. Features an on-site computer resource lab for job searches, resume printing, direct employer hiring events, and dedicated priority counseling for military veterans.

Orientation & Follow-Up Steps:
Step 1: Complete the online WIOA orientation request form directly at: https://workinmonmouth.com/orientation/
Step 2: Check your inbox (and your Spam / Junk folder) for an email confirming your orientation request, which will provide your scheduled date and time.
Step 3: If you do not see a confirmation email within 3 to 5 business days, call the One-Stop Career Center directly at (732) 683-8850 to follow up and ensure your orientation spot is confirmed.
